passage.label: Remind Muhammad grace Lord not soothsayer madman; say poet await misfortune time; say wait indeed with you among wait; minds command this transgressing people; say made up rather not believe; produce statement like it truthful; created nothing creators themselves; create heavens earth rather not certain; depositories Lord control; stairway heaven listen listener produce clear authority; daughters you sons; ask payment weighed debt; unseen write down; intend plan disbelieve against them plan; deity other Allah exalted above associate; see fragment sky falling say clouds brought layers; leave meet Day struck unconscious; Day plan not avail nor helped; indeed wronged punishment besides most not know; patient Muhammad decision Lord indeed Our eyes exalt praise Lord arise; part night exalt after setting stars

arabicExcerpts.text: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ
فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

mainSubject.label: Reminder commissioned by the Lord's grace affirming the Prophet is neither soothsayer nor madman; their accusation of poet awaiting misfortune answered by mutual waiting; their minds commanding this or they being transgressors; the fabrication charge countered by their disbelief and challenge to produce a like statement; five rhetorical questions exposing their incoherence — created from nothing or self-created, creators of cosmos yet uncertain, possessing divine depositories or control, having a heavenly stairway with authoritative listener, attributing daughters to Allah while claiming sons; further challenges on payment demanded, unseen knowledge written down, plotted plans recoiling on plotters, and any deity besides the Exalted Allah; even seeing a sky-fragment fall they would dismiss it as layered clouds; commanded to leave them until their Day of unconsciousness when plans fail and no help arrives; wrongdoers facing additional punishment unknown to most; patience commanded under the Lord's decision with the Prophet held in divine sight, timed praise upon arising, during part of the night and after the stars set

Poet-accusation answered by mutual waiting for outcome

Creators of heavens and earth yet uncertain
Possessing divine depositories or exercising control over them
Having a heavenly stairway upon which they listen
Let their listener produce a clear authority
Attributing daughters to Allah while claiming sons for themselves
Payment demanded so they are weighed down by debt
Unseen knowledge claimed and written down
Plotting plans that recoil upon the plotters
No deity besides Allah; He is exalted above what they associate

That Day their plan will not avail them nor will they be helped
Wrongdoers facing additional punishment besides that
Most of them do not know about this additional punishment

Timed praise upon arising, during part of the night and after the stars set

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: So remind; by the grace of your Lord you are not a soothsayer or a madman.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck unconscious.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Be patient for the decision of your Lord; indeed you are in Our eyes; exalt with praise when you arise.
And in a part of the night exalt Him and after the setting of the stars.

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the burn-patiently-or-impatiently verdict (16) before the righteous-reward block opens (17); P2 ends with the Beneficent-Merciful attribution (28) before the reminder-commission begins (29); P3 runs from that commission through the rhetorical challenges, sky-fragment dismissal, Day-of-unconsciousness and the closing timed-praise command (29-49).
